name: Fair Share Tokaido
tagline: Both want-lists almost fully in (Pegasis 24 of 25, Aoki about 43 of 49), with one-person places done as short split half-days, and only one hotel for all 5 nights in the west.
summary: Tokyo 3 nights with the anime places you both chose and a self-driven Daikoku night. A 2-day rental car takes you through Kawasaki, the Hakone Turnpike and Mt Fuji to Mishima. Then 5 nights in ONE Osaka hotel: Nara's hill fire (Sat Jan 23), Suzuka EV karts (Sun Jan 24), Kyoto/Kobe and Liberty Walk are day trips. Fly Kansai → Sapporo for 3 nights in a Niseko onsen ryokan (ski, Rusutsu drift) and 2 in Sapporo, and both fly home from New Chitose on Feb 2.

who.pegasis: In: 24 of 25 WANTs — Daikoku (you drive, no guide), Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba, TMG, Isetan depachika, Skyliner/bus in, Golden Gai, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, SHELTER with a live show, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro, Nara fire, Suzuka EV kart, Toyota/Nagoya part of the Tokaido car road, Niseko, Rusutsu drift, Asahiyama penguins, GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a full extra day). Your 'maybe' picks: Kobe beef and night view, Shinsekai + Spa World, Osu, Nijo Market.
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs — all Tokyo anime places (Suga, Shimokita, SHELTER, Nakano, Akihabara, ZEST, Ikebukuro, GBC Tokyo Station and Hachiko), Kawasaki Girls Band Cry walk (plaza, Marufuku, CITTA', Lazona, Miharashi), Nissan Crossing, Shibuya Sky + Nintendo/Pokémon, Chinatown dinner, Daikoku + Umihotaru, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Hakone/Eva views, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Nara, Suzuka, Toyota museum, Inari dawn + Kinkakuji, Sabbat places (Kyoto, Osaka, Kobe), Kuromon/Dotonbori, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Niseko beginner day, Rusutsu, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Enoshima/Slam Dunk and Cup Noodles (no free half-day), Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Yako and Toyota Kaikan (Kaikan closed Sundays).

cost.transport: ≈ ¥110,000 per person (Tokyo car 2 days incl. one-way fee about ¥11,000 not checked, tolls and fuel ≈ ¥31,000; Mishima → Shin-Osaka ¥12,500; Kansai/Suzuka trains ≈ ¥22,000; Jetstar + bag ≈ ¥9,600; Hokkaido 4WD 4 days ≈ ¥23,000; Asahikawa JR ≈ ¥11,000; the rest local)
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥170,000 per person (Super Hotel Shinjuku 3 nights ¥25,700; Hanz ¥14,900; Dormy Inn Namba 5 nights ≈ ¥50,000 not checked; Niseko Grand Hotel 3 nights with 2 meals ≈ ¥60,000 not checked; Route-Inn Sapporo 2 nights ≈ ¥16,000)
cost.activities: ≈ ¥75,000 per person (Niseko ski + rental + Aoki lesson, Rusutsu drift ≈ ¥25,000 average, Suzuka, Shibuya Sky, SHELTER, museums, Moiwa, zoo)
cost.total: ≈ ¥355,000 per person, plus food about ¥5,000 a day (≈ ¥70,000) = ≈ ¥425,000

flights: Pegasis: open-jaw, CA$1,247 (Google Flights, Sep 2026). Out: WestJet Toronto 09:35 Mon Jan 18 → Calgary → Narita 16:30 Tue Jan 19. Home: Air Canada New Chitose 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 the same day (check: the timetable also shows 19:55).

Aoki: Air China Shanghai → Narita, lands 13:40 Tue Jan 19 (about CA$300). Home: Spring Airlines New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2 (about ¥83,000 one way on Feb 2; Chinese New Year prices, book early). Day 15 = visa day 15.
Osaka → Hokkaido: Jetstar Kansai 09:50 → New Chitose 11:50, Thu Jan 28 (from ¥7,110 + checked bag about ¥2,000–2,500; Google Flights, Sep 2026).

places.blurb: Both of you land here on Tue Jan 19. Aoki lands about 3 hours before Pegasis, so she goes ahead into Tokyo.

info.label: To Shinjuku
info.value: Bus ¥1,500 + JR, or Skyliner ¥2,310 online + JR

tips: Register in Visit Japan Web before the flight for the immigration QR code.
Pegasis: ask for a paper entry stamp; some rental car shops want to see it.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: The brick dome where Nina arrives in Tokyo in Girls Band Cry episode 1. The airport bus stops next to the station.
tips: Look up: the dome ceiling is the shot from the anime.

places.ja: NISSAN CROSSING（ニッサン クロッシング）
places.blurb: Nissan's free showroom on the main Ginza crossing, with new and special cars and a café. A 30-minute stop.
tips: Check the site for the cars on show in January 2027.

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: Your Tokyo base for 3 nights: a small economy twin with a free breakfast buffet and a carbonated-spring public bath. Omoide Yokocho, Golden Gai and Isetan are all within 10 minutes on foot.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast about ¥16,000–17,800 a night (Jalan, seen Sep 25, 2026)

info.label: Parking
info.value: None: use a coin car park nearby on Jan 21

tips: Book on the official site with the free Smart Membership: about ¥500 back per night.
Kabukicho is noisy at night: ask for a high floor.

places.blurb: The basement food hall of Isetan. From about 19:00 sushi, bento and deli food get 20–50% stickers before the 20:00 close.
tips: Brand counters do not always cut prices; look at the bento and sushi counters.

places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. Each bar has 6 to 12 seats.
tips: A seat charge (お通し) of ¥300–500 is normal.
If one bar is full, walk on: there are about 80.

places.blurb: About 200 tiny bars in 6 narrow lanes, 5 minutes from the hotel. Each bar seats 5 to 10 people.
tips: Look for a sign at the door: some bars do not take tourists or charge a cover.

places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.
tips: Stay on one side of the stairs: people live here.

places.blurb: A free observatory 202 m up in the city hall. Mt Fuji is clearest on winter mornings.
tips: Security check at the entrance: allow 10 min.

places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, trading cards, model kits and anime goods, opposite Akihabara station.

info.label: Station
info.value: 秋葉原駅 電気街口

tips: Start at the top floor and walk down.

places.blurb: A small live venue: the model for 'BEAST', where Ai performs in Oshi no Ko episode 1. Photos of the front only.
tips: Do not block the entrance if there is a queue for a show.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
places.blurb: The big maid café chain, with a small stage show. First-timers get a 'passport'. No table charge.

info.label: Cost
info.value: ¥880 per hour + food; about ¥2,000–2,500 with lunch

tips: Book on the official site.
Walk past street touts: go only to real shops.

places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2 to 4 are full of used figures, manga and toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: many small shops open late.

places.blurb: The home of Kessoku Band in Bocchi the Rock: small live houses, used-clothing shops and record stores.
tips: Eat dinner here before the show: many cheap curry shops.

places.blurb: The basement live house that is the model for STARRY. You go to a real evening show and stand inside like Bocchi's band.
tips: Buy the ticket online and print it at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart.
Standing only; you enter by the number on your ticket.

places.ja: アニメイト池袋本店・駿河屋 池袋
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods. The 9-floor Animate main store faces Surugaya and Lashinbang for used goods.
tips: Surugaya and Lashinbang are usually cheapest for used goods; compare before you buy.

places.blurb: Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center Shibuya are on the same floor of Shibuya PARCO. Hachiko (Girls Band Cry ep 3) is 7 min away.
tips: Thursday is much calmer than the weekend.

places.blurb: An open-air roof 230 m above the Shibuya crossing. Enter before 15:00 on the cheaper ticket and stay for sunset and the city lights.

info.label: Sale
info.value: Web tickets open 2 weeks before (about Jan 7)

tips: The roof closes in strong wind or rain.

places.ja: タイムズカー 新宿
places.blurb: Pick up the car for 2 days: Daikoku tonight, then Kawasaki, Hakone and Fuji, and drop it at Mishima station.

info.label: Must
info.value: Studless winter tyres (スタッドレスタイヤ)

tips: Book studless tyres and an ETC card.
Bring passport, licence and IDP (Pegasis) / Japan-valid licence (Aoki).

places.blurb: Japan's largest Chinatown, 20 minutes from Daikoku. Dinner stop before the car meet.
tips: Cup Noodles Museum closes 18:00, so it is not in this plan.

places.blurb: The famous JDM car meet in a loop of expressway ramps. Pegasis drives in himself, no guide.

info.label: Access
info.value: By car only (Shuto Wangan / Bayshore route)

tips: If police close the PA, drive on to Umihotaru.

places.blurb: A rest-stop island in the middle of Tokyo Bay on the Aqualine. Night view of the bay and cars.
tips: Very windy and cold on the top deck.

places.ja: 川崎駅東口 駅前広場
places.blurb: The most important Girls Band Cry place: Nina first hears Momoka play here. Marufuku Coffee (stamp no. 1) is below it in Azalea B1F; CLUB CITTA' is 5 min south.
tips: Eat the hotcake breakfast at Marufuku Coffee.
CLUB CITTA' is inside for ticket holders only: look at La Cittadella from the street.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: The open-air stage where the band plays in episode 3. Get the anime angle from the 4F and 5F walkways.
tips: HMV on 4F sometimes sells GBC goods.

places.blurb: The wide concrete steps on the Tama River from episode 2 and the key art.
tips: Park the car in a coin car park near Lazona and walk.

places.ja: アネスト岩田ターンパイク箱根
places.blurb: A 14 km private toll road from Odawara up to 1,000 m, with long smooth curves. Pegasis drives.
tips: Stay in your lane: the curves are blind.

places.blurb: The top of the Turnpike at 1,011 m. Mt Fuji stands behind Lake Ashi, the valley that is Tokyo-3 in Evangelion.
tips: Lunch at the viewpoint café.

places.blurb: The pass from Sengokuhara (Evangelion's Geofront valley) down to Gotemba, with a famous Fuji view from the rest stop.
tips: The Sengokuhara drive before the pass is the Tokyo-3 valley.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A large outlet mall with Mt Fuji behind it. Good for ski wear before Hokkaido.
tips: Ask for the tourist coupon book at the information desk (passport).

places.ja: 富士モータースポーツミュージアム
places.blurb: A museum at the gate of Fuji Speedway with about 100 years of race cars from Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others.
tips: 20 min by car from Gotemba outlets.

places.blurb: Mt Fuji straight across the lake. At sunset the snow on Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold after sunset; wear the ski jacket.

places.blurb: A Fuji-view villa with its own hot tub and breakfast, rated 9.4. Aoki's pick for the one Fuji night.
tips: Confirm that your villa has its own bath.
Half board is +CA$126; otherwise eat in Kawaguchiko town.

places.blurb: Where Rin camps in Yuru Camp episode 1: the Fuji view on the 1,000-yen note. Best in the morning.
tips: Roads can be icy at dawn: drive slowly.

places.ja: レンタカー 三島駅
places.blurb: Return the car here with a full tank, then take the Shinkansen west.
tips: Fill the tank near the station: a gas station receipt may be asked.

places.ja: 天然温泉 夕霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんば
places.blurb: Your one west base for 5 nights: Nara, Suzuka, Kyoto, Kobe and Liberty Walk are all day trips. Hot-spring bath and free late-night ramen.

info.label: Price
info.value: Not checked; about ¥18,000–25,000 a night for a twin (estimate)

tips: Check-in 15:00; they keep bags from the morning.
Book early: 5 nights in one hotel means no packing until Hokkaido.

places.blurb: The giant bronze Buddha in one of the largest wooden buildings in the world, with the Nara deer all around.
tips: Go in before 16:00.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

places.blurb: A wide open field in Nara Park with a clear view of Wakakusa hill: fireworks at 18:15, the whole hill set on fire at 18:30.
tips: Cancelled in bad weather, with no second date.
Trains back are crowded: walk to Kintetsu-Nara by 19:15.

places.blurb: The Japanese F1 track. In the park you drive an EV kart on the real East Course; no licence needed.
tips: The park is closed Jan 26–29; Jan 24 is one of 4 open days.
Buy the kart tickets online before the day.

places.en: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
places.ja: トヨタ産業技術記念館
places.blurb: Toyota's first red-brick loom factory: looms, then cars built step by step with robot demos.
tips: Open on Sunday; Toyota Kaikan in Toyota City is closed on Sundays.

places.blurb: Covered shopping streets with old games, used electronics, anime shops and street food, around Osu Kannon temple.
tips: Try tebasaki wings or a Taiwan ramen.

places.blurb: The famous Nagoya miso katsu chain, next to the station. Dinner before the Shinkansen back.
tips: Queues are shorter after 17:00 on Sunday.

places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up the hill. At 7:00 the tunnels are almost empty.

info.label: From Namba
info.value: Keihan line from Yodoyabashi, about 45 min

tips: Walk to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint (about 40 min up) and back.

places.blurb: The gold pavilion. If snow fell in the night, it has a white roof: only 1–3 mornings a winter.
tips: Be at the gate at 9:00, before the tour buses.

places.ja: 京都コンサートホール
places.blurb: The building used as the school in Sabbat of the Witch. Outside photos only.
tips: Match the game CG from the front plaza.

places.blurb: The covered shopping arcade where the heroine takes on the giant ramen challenge in Sabbat of the Witch.

info.label: Station
info.value: 京都市役所前 / 三条

tips: Eat ramen here for the scene.

places.ja: スターバックスコーヒー 神戸北野異人館店
places.blurb: A Starbucks inside a 1907 Western-style house: café Schwarze Katze in Sabbat of the Witch.
tips: The inside was renovated, so it differs from the game CG.

places.blurb: The red tower on the harbour, reopened in 2024 with an open-air roof deck. Sunset and the Kobe night view.

info.label: Ticket
info.value: About ¥1,200 + ¥200 for the roof deck (timed ticket)

tips: Chosen over Mt Maya: the Maya ropeway stops at 17:30 on winter weekdays and had long January inspection closures in past years.

places.ja: ステーキランド神戸館
places.blurb: A well-known low-cost teppanyaki steak house near Sannomiya: Kobe beef cooked in front of you.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Kobe beef dinner set about ¥6,000–10,000; normal steak sets cheaper (check)

tips: Aoki can order a normal steak or chicken set.

places.blurb: A covered market street: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fruit and cooked seafood.
tips: Aoki: choose grilled and cooked stalls, not raw.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: electronics on Sakaisuji and the side street Otaroad full of figure, game and doujin shops.
tips: Animate and Melonbooks are 2 min apart.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 大阪日本橋オタロード店
places.blurb: The Osaka shop of the same maid café chain, on Otaroad. A break between shops.
tips: For a quieter one, CCOちゃ opens 15:00 on weekdays.

places.blurb: The Glico sign and the canal lights. Takoyaki and okonomiyaki all along Dotonbori.
tips: Busy until late; keep bags in front.

places.ja: 裏なんば・法善寺横丁
places.blurb: Small standing bars and izakaya in the back streets behind Namba, 5 min from the hotel.
tips: Hozenji's moss-covered statue is lit at night.

places.romaji: Jē Dī Emu Pāku / Eru Bī Doraibu In
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's wide-body cars, goods shop and a Sanuki udon shop, opened in 2025.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Official site 11:00–21:00 daily; Instagram 11:00–19:00, closed Thu

tips: Wednesday is open on both sources; do not go on Thursday.

places.blurb: Retro Osaka under the Tsutenkaku tower: deep-fried kushikatsu skewers.
tips: No double-dipping in the shared sauce.

places.blurb: A huge hot-spring bath house with 'Europe' and 'Asia' bath floors. Pegasis only.
tips: Bath floors switch between men and women each month.

places.blurb: The date mall in Sabbat of the Witch, next to Osaka Station. Pokémon Center Osaka is 5 min away in Daimaru Umeda.
tips: Aoki's afternoon: Sabbat photos, then Pokémon Center.

places.blurb: Jetstar to New Chitose leaves from here.
tips: Check the Jetstar terminal on the booking; allow 20 min more if it is Terminal 2.

places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. Rental car counters send a free shuttle to their lots.
tips: Snow delays are common: keep phone numbers of the hotel and the car shop.

places.ja: ニセコグランドホテル
places.blurb: Your onsen ryokan for 3 nights at Niseko Konbu Onsen: Japanese rooms, dinner and breakfast plans, and a large garden outdoor bath with two hot springs. 10 min by car from the Annupuri slopes.

info.label: Price
info.value: Not checked for January; room only for 2 was ¥15,000 on an October date

tips: The big outdoor bath is mixed; bath wear (湯あみ着) is given. Bathing is optional.
Ask for a Japanese-style room (和室).

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
places.blurb: The gentle, wide side of Niseko: Aoki's first ski lesson, while Pegasis skis the powder above.
tips: Book Aoki's beginner lesson ahead.
Skip Strawberry Fields: going left leads to steep chutes.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course at Rusutsu with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. You drive yourself with an instructor next to you.
tips: Book by 17:00 the day before; email first about Pegasis's 1-year licence.
Bring passport, licence and IDP.

places.ja: ルスツリゾートスキー場
places.blurb: A big ski resort with long groomed runs and tree runs, next to the drift course.
tips: Last lifts about 16:00–17:00: leave by 15:45 to drive back in daylight.

places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a thin spicy soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables.
tips: Be in the queue by 11:20 on Sunday.

places.ja: レンタカー 札幌駅北口
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here. Sapporo is on foot and subway from now on.
tips: Fill the tank first.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel with a public bath and free breakfast buffet, 5 min from Susukino and Daruma.
tips: Book the early-bird plan by about Jan 4.

places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a viewpoint above the whole of Sapporo. Go up before sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Free shuttle bus from the streetcar stop ロープウェイ入口.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: The most famous Jingisukan (grilled lamb) shop in Sapporo, since 1954: a small counter with dome pans.
tips: Cash is safest.
Your clothes will smell of lamb: wear the old jacket.

places.blurb: King penguins walk a 500 m loop through the snow between the visitors. Also polar bears and seals.
tips: Stand on the route by 10:45 for the 11:00 walk.

places.blurb: Ranked by a Sapporo local as the best soup curry shop, above GARAKU. A second soup curry to compare.
tips: Check the hours on Google Maps the day before; if closed, eat Sapporo miso ramen.

places.ja: ビックカメラ 札幌店
places.blurb: Last tax-free shopping next to Sapporo Station: electronics, cosmetics and snacks.
tips: Show the tourist coupon on your phone before you pay.

places.blurb: A central market for crab, uni and salmon roe bowls. Pegasis's last lunch.
tips: Shops at the edge of the market are cheaper than the ones at the front.

days.title: Land in Tokyo, first night in Shinjuku
days.titleJa: 成田 → 東京駅 → 新宿
days.summary: Aoki lands first and sees the Girls Band Cry dome at Tokyo Station and Nissan Crossing on her way in. You meet at the hotel, buy half-price food at Isetan and end with yakitori and Golden Gai.
alerts: TMG observatory is closed today (3rd Tuesday): it is on Day 2.
Aoki: show the Don Quijote tourist coupon with your passport if you shop tonight.
days.split: Aoki lands at 13:40 and goes ahead; Pegasis lands at 16:30. You meet at the hotel at 19:00.

stops.note: Girls Band Cry ep 1: Nina arrives under this dome.
Half-price stickers on sushi and bento in the basement food hall.
Yakitori and a beer in a tiny bar.
One or two drinks in a bar that takes tourists.

Book the Maidreamin table on the official site.

Free observatory; Mt Fuji on a clear morning. Pegasis comes straight here from the hotel.
Oshi no Ko's BEAST from outside, 3 min away.

Thursday: Daikoku is rarely closed, but check X/Twitter before you go.

Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center; Hachiko on the way to the Sky.

JDM car meet; Pegasis drives in.
Island rest stop in the bay.

Tatsumi PA is left out: the loop would end after midnight.

days.title: Kawasaki Girls Band Cry walk, Hakone Turnpike, Fuji at sunset
days.titleJa: 川崎 → 箱根ターンパイク → 大観山 → 乙女峠 → 御殿場 → 河口湖

days.summary: Morning: the Girls Band Cry places around Kawasaki Station. Afternoon: Pegasis drives the Turnpike to Taikanzan and over Otome Pass; at Gotemba he shops while Aoki drives 20 min to the Fuji Motorsports Museum.
alerts: Check out at 07:45 and load the car.
Check the Hakone and Fuji road reports in the morning (winter tyres needed).
Be at the lake by 16:40: no driving on snowy roads after dark.
